tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhing skyong dbang po mchod thabs mdor bsdus bzhed don lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje dang / /dbyer med bla ma la btud nas/ /zhing skyong dbang po mchod pa'i thabs/ /bzhed don lhun grub 'di spro 'o/ /mchod gtor rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du dgra bgegs ma lus pa bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha rus kyi gtor ma/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga yi me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhu chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga sogs rol mo'i bye brag gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad sprin phung 'thib pa ltar gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a warta ya a warta ya ho/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes brjod nas/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su pad nyi dang dgra bgegs kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs rnams tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs can sku mdog nag po/ g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ mi rus kyi phreng ba phyag 'gag tu brgyus pa/ chang gis gang ba'i bum pa dang rtse gsum mchan khung du bsnams pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ smin ma dmar ser me ltar du 'bar ba/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa nyer gcig gi do shal can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang /

rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar mo/ rgyab tu siṅga lī ma ser nag bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rgyan med pa rab tu grims shing khros pa'i cha lugs can/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod sogs nas nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs can yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rnga sil dang bcas te/ hūm̐ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod la sogs nas/ /kīṃ kīṃ sgra sgrogs bram ze'i gzugs can khyod/ /mang mang ḍā ki'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa/ /myur myur rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs/ /oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ mtshan ldan drag po'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir/ /dam ldan rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /bcud ldan dam rdzas thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir/ /stobs ldan zhing skyong 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā sogs nas/ wā ra pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ de nas gtor sngags sogs phyag len ltar byas la/ hūm̐/ dpal chen rdo rje 'chang gi bka' rgya yis/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i srung mar legs bskos pa/ /stobs chen zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas la/ /rgya chen rdzas kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul lo/ /dgra bgegs sha rus gtor ma'i ri bo dang / /khrag mchod la sogs drag po'i nyer spyod tshogs/ /dngos su 'byor dang ting 'dzin las byung ba'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /lha chen mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang / /zhing skyong gzhi ldan dbang phyug thugs dam bskang /

/bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang / /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i thugs dam bskang / /las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu'i thugs dam bskang / /ser nag siṅga lī ma'i thugs dam bskang / /dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor gyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /ting 'dzin mi gsal bzlas brjod nyung ba dang / /dam rdzas ma tshang mchod gtor chag la sogs/ /rmongs pa'i dbang gis nongs pa gang bgyis pa/ /'gyod pas bshags so bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar mngon sum du/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /rdo rje gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /sdang mig tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar bar byed/ /hūm̐ phaṭ sgra yis bdud kyi snying yang 'gas/ /dmigs med thugs kyis chos dbyings grogs su bsnyen/ /khrag 'thung dpa' bo khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /du ma'i mtshan 'chang dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs/ /'jigs byed tshangs skud mi mgo'i phreng ba can/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na 'gying / /mdung thung gri gug bum thod 'dzin la bstod/ /phyogs bzhir dmar ser ljang nag khros pa'i zhal/ /thugs kyi dgyes sde bde skyong mkha' 'gro ma/ /gcer mo brkyang bskum gri thod legs 'dzin pa'i/ /gsang ba'i yum chen 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /de lta'i mchod bstod yid 'ong pad+mo'i tshogs/ /tshogs gsum rin chen snod du legs spungs te/ /gus pas zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyod la snying nas gus pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /tshe la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing / /mi mthun rgud pa'i tshogs rnams zhi ba dang / /rnam dkar dge ba 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /'gro la byams pas ngag gi dbang phyug mchog /brtse chen snying po'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong gis/

/mkhas kun dga' mdzad bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams/ /zhabs brtan phrin las rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten mes po'i tshe dang dbang po'i dpal/ /gtsug na zla ba'i stobs dang ngal gso'i bu'i/ /'byor pa la sogs legs pa'i yon tan kun/ /skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir 'du bar mdzod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i gzim gzhan du/ rnam par rgyal ba'i gnas mchog 'di nyid du/ khang 'og ma ru/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal g.yang kun 'du zhing / /stobs 'byor chang gis myos pa'i dregs ldan rnams/ /dbang med gus shing 'dud pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /rnam dag tshul khrims bslab pas rgyud sdom zhing / /'khrul med klog spong bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyis/ /rgyun gyi dbang po'i chos grwa 'gengs par mdzod/ /mdor na rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla shel ltar/ /'phel zhing srid zhi'i phyogs las rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /mthon por 'degs pa'i bkra shis rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni mdo sngags bstan pa'i gsal byed gzim 'og mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin phrin las dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' lung gser gyi rdo rje spyi bor phebs pa gus pas blangs te/ yul li thang phyogs su skyes pa'i ban 'khyams/ 'jam dbyangs rab dga'i snang ba tshangs byung dgyes pa'i blo ldan du 'bod pas shrī na len+d+ra'i chos grwar sbyar ba dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sde ston a 'jam/ zhing skyong dbang po mchod thabs mdor bsdus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
